premise.logline: An estate agent falls for the one buyer who can see what is wrong with the house she is desperate to sell.

modules.theme: honesty as a thing that costs money
modules.setting_place: a seaside town where every other house is for sale
modules.protagonist: an estate agent one bad month from losing the agency
modules.protagonist_want: to close the sale without lying outright
modules.antagonism: her own need for the commission
modules.complication: the buyer is a surveyor pretending not to be one
modules.ending_shape: the sale falls through and the relationship does not
